description: SPENDS CREDITS: quote_outreach_retry first, show the price, after the user's yes pass its `credits` as confirm_credits. [REST: POST /api/tasks/{id}/outreach/retry]

cids.description: The failed people to retry; omitted: every failed person of the generation.

confirm_credits.description: The price in credits the matching quote returned, shown to the user and confirmed by them.

generation_id.description: The outreach generation id (get_outreach campaign.generation.id); omitted: the current one.

task_id.description: The search id (task id), e.g. from list_searches or create_search.

name: retry_outreach
title: Retry failed people (spends credits)
